**Check Collision Potential:** Let $d_{min}$ be the smallest distance to the scene geometry found during the march step.
Let $R_{group}$ be the maximum distance from the center ray to any corner of the beam group at the current step position.
**Split Decision:** If $d_{min} \le R_{group}$, there is a potential collision for at least one ray in the group.
